name: sukhomlinsky-education-kb
title_zh: 按主题翻苏霍姆林斯基原典的目录卡片盒
tagline_zh: 问“苏霍姆林斯基怎么看后进生/劳动教育”，不再翻十本书碰运气。先读 INDEX。
tagline_en: Ask "what did Sukhomlinsky say about underachievers or labor education" and skip the 10-book hunt. INDEX first.
desc_en: 按教育主题检索苏霍姆林斯基教育思想与案例的纯 Markdown 知识库。用于回答“苏霍姆林斯基怎么看后进生/家校合作/劳动教育/美育/教师成长”等问题，或按主题阅读带出处的思想与案例。先读 INDEX.md，再进入 topics/ 与 cards/。
why_zh: 不是二手转述，是纯 Markdown 的原文脉络。先 INDEX 后 topics/cards 的两级…
why_en: Not secondhand summaries — pure Markdown with traceable structure. INDEX → topics → cards gives you a citable path from question.
limit_zh: 只覆盖苏霍姆林斯基一人，且仅限库内已收录主题；不含其他教育家观点，也不做跨版本译文比对。卡片是摘录与索引。
limit_en: Covers only Sukhomlinsky and only topics already in the repo. No other educators, no translation comparison. Cards are excerpts + pointers, not.
title_en: Topic-first index into Sukhomlinsky's own words
